title: Algorithmic Trading Platform Early Adopters
author: ALGORAONE1
selftext:
Hello fellow investors/traders,

I wanted to share my project to some people who might be interested. Essentially, I built a platform that enables users to create, backtest, and automate algorithmic strategies on a single platform. Supported brokerages include Robinhood, Webull, [Public.com](http://Public.com), Tastytrade, and much more. The platform also has its own research desk that submits strategies and portfolios which users can read as multiple reports are typically submitted every weekday. Lastly, users can import their existing strategies written in Pine Script, think Script, Python, and more.

  
We are currently looking for our first few users! 

  
Anyone interested in early adoption can visit us at [www.algora1.com](http://www.algora1.com) ! 

  
Thank you.
